challenge.better_approach: A git post-merge hook to re-walk: it catches pulls but not a hand-copied tree, and it is a host-seam with its own drift. The floor already runs on every command and already calls the walk, so the trigger widens where it stands.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the trigger check is cheap: about 25 -e tests per command. That is to be measured in the tooth's run time, not assumed.
challenge.prior_art: cairn_wire_instances in cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh is the recipe (ticket 0853294fe972; per-file unit, ticket f0ffa0db0952); bin/cairn already re-walks for a missing superclaude (measured 2026-11-11) and wires one addressed instance on dispatch. This composes on both.
challenge.real_collision: None: no intention says a class verb waits for a hand to be linked.

answers.falsifier: RED if, with cairn/0 and the superclaude launcher present, a class verb's instance link absent, one bin/cairn run leaves it absent.
answers.from_idea: none, because it was measured 2026-11-12: on akiendelllinux ~/.cairn/devices/web_server/0/bin/web_server was absent and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_cli_reaches.py redded; on akienasus ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/bin/question is absent while cairn/devices/librarian/0/bin/question is executable
answers.how: bin/cairn's _floor runs the full cairn_wire_instances walk (cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh) only when cairn/0 is absent or the superclaude launcher is missing; widen that trigger to: any executable cairn/devices/<dev>/0/bin/<verb> with no entry at $INSTANCE_ROOT/<dev>/0/bin/<verb>. The walk is idempotent and never overwrites a real file. Red-first tooth in bin/proofs/test_superclaude_is_never_refused_by_the_floor.py's pattern.
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (a launcher laid by hand on every box is a settled answer re-derived) and Law 4 (the wiring rule is physics only for the first run; afterwards it is a hand's memory).
answers.what: Every executable verb in a device's class-space 0/bin is linked at its instance-space address by bin/cairn's floor, including verbs and devices that landed after the box's first wiring walk.

bullets.text: The instance wiring walk runs only on a box's first floor; class verbs added later stay unlinked until dispatched through bin/cairn or laid by hand.
